description: Modelled on rules-for-robots#28/#29 (Open3DBroadcast WebRTC receiver). A review note, tagged as needing library verification, says to register only the labelled data callback. The vendored library's async connect loop only calls the unlabelled callback, and the fake used by the tests calls whichever is registered, so the change passes tests and breaks the receiver. The good outcome keeps the unlabelled callback and reports that the finding does not hold.
